name: (BERSERK) Immortal Zodd
description: You awaken in a dark forest, where Nosferatu Zodd's heavy footsteps and roar already echo through the trees. The legendary apostle has hunted you from the very beginning. This is more than survival—it is a duel in which every second may be your last. Can you escape his crushing blows, lure him into a trap, or face him with nothing but strength and cunning? Prepare for a battle against a demon more powerful than anything in this ruined world.
